text: I believe a chill struck for a moment to every heart. “He was a seaman,” said George Merry, who, bolder than the rest, had gone up close and was examining the rags of clothing. “Leastways, this is good sea-cloth.” “Aye, aye,” said Silver; “like enough; you wouldn’t look to find a bishop here, I reckon. But what sort of a way is that for bones to lie? ’Tain’t in natur’.” Indeed, on a second glance, it seemed impossible to fancy that the body was in a natural position.
